title: Contrastive uncertainty learning for robust multi-structure segmentation in lower-pelvic MR
abstract: arXiv:2610.20251v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Boundary delineation of anatomical structures in prostate MRI is often compromised by regional ambiguity. Automated segmentation methods relying on global overlap loss functions tend to be insensitive to surface deviations, leading to significant errors in ambiguous regions. Most existing uncertainty-aware methods treat uncertainty as a post-hoc quality indicator or prediction filter. We propose Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL), a supervised framework that uses predictive uncertainty to directly guide representation learning. Using Monte Carlo Dropout, CUL identifies voxel-wise uncertainty and structures the embedding geometry accordingly: low-uncertainty, correctly predicted features form stable voxels while high-uncertainty or misclassified features are actively repelled, preventing feature collapse at difficult boundaries. We evaluate CUL on a 589-scan 3D prostate MRI multi-structure segmentation task (8 anatomical structures)

translated_title: 基于对比不确定性学习的下盆腔MRI鲁棒多结构分割
translated_abstract: 前列腺MRI中解剖结构的边界勾勒常常受到区域模糊性的影响。依赖全局重叠损失函数的自动分割方法往往对表面偏差不敏感，导致在模糊区域出现显著误差。现有的大多数不确定性感知方法将不确定性视为事后质量指标或预测过滤器。我们提出了对比不确定性学习，这是一个监督框架，利用预测不确定性直接指导表示学习。CUL使用蒙特卡洛Dropout识别体素级不确定性，并据此构建嵌入几何结构：低不确定性且正确预测的特征形成稳定体素，而高不确定性或错误分类的特征则被主动排斥，从而防止在困难边界处发生特征塌缩。我们在一个包含589例扫描的3D前列腺MRI多结构分割任务（8个解剖结构）上对CUL进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出对比不确定性学习框架，利用蒙特卡洛Dropout产生的体素级不确定性直接指导特征表示学习，通过排斥高不确定性特征防止边界处特征塌缩，从而提升前列腺MRI八结构分割在模糊区域的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Contrastive Uncertainty Learning (CUL), a supervised framework that uses Monte Carlo Dropout-derived voxel-wise uncertainty to directly guide representation learning by repelling high-uncertainty features, achieving robust multi-structure segmentation in lower-pelvic MRI.
